+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
+<class name="CollisionPresets2D" inherits="Object" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="../class.xsd">
+	<brief_description>
+		Helper class for working with 2D collision presets.
+	</brief_description>
+	<description>
+		Collision presets provide an abstraction over collision masks and layers that allow masks and layers to be synchronized between objects, as well as other functionality. Presets are generally referenced via an internal [int] ID, with the special values [code]0[/code] and [code]-1[/code] used to represent [b]default[/b] and [b]custom[/b] presets respectively.
+		[b]Note: [/b] This class does not expose methods to set the values of collision presets; this is not generally recommended, especially at runtime as objects only read collision presets when created. This setting contains an array of dictionaries, each of which have the properties: [code]id[/code] : [int], [code]name[/code] : [String], [code]layer[/code] : [int], and [code]mask[/code] : [int].
